adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts (createAllCalendarEvents), when a destination has credentialId but it isn’t found in this.calendarCredentials, the code fetches it from DB with `include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}` and only reconstructs `credential` if `credentialFromDB && credentialFromDB.app?.slug` is truthy. If the credential exists but has a missing/nullable `app` relation (or slug), `credential` remains undefined and the destination is silently skipped (no createEvent call, no log). The same pattern appears in updateAllCalendarEvents’ new DB fetch block. This can lead to calendar events not being created/updated with no visibility, i.e., broken behavior/data loss for those destinations.
